definitions.sampling_unit: solver seed after exact aggregation over twelve waves
definitions.t95_t99: first step reaching 95%/99% of the within-budget total gain
definitions.last_improvement: last strict best-so-far decrease larger than 1e-9
definitions.edge_improvement: last strict decrease occurs at the final budget step
definitions.last_ten_percent_share: gain from floor(0.9*horizon) through the horizon divided by total gain
definitions.runtime: internal complete-instance timer including evaluator setup and validation; the sum of twelve wave timers is retained separately
definitions.seconds_to_t95_t99: unavailable: convergence points contain no per-step timestamps; exact t95/t99 are reported only in iterations/generations
definitions.sa_budget_relation: SA 10k and 50k are independent schedules, each cooling from 60 to 0.05 with its own geometric alpha; SA 10k is not a prefix of SA 50k
definitions.ga_budget_relation: GA 40/100/200 use the same seed labels but one RNG stream is consumed sequentially over waves. A longer horizon in an earlier wave shifts the RNG state for later waves, so full-instance curves are alternative horizons rather than shared prefixes. Best-objective prefix equality is recorded as a descriptive audit and is not required.
definitions.paired_budget_confidence_intervals: two-sided Student-t 95% intervals over paired solver-seed contrasts
definitions.figure: mean percentage gain from each run's own start with two-sided Student-t 95% intervals; dotted vertical lines mark 90% of each budget
